resources.string: Use your phone as a Bluetooth keyboard to turn pages.
Keep this app open while testing. Volume buttons are planned after the Bluetooth HID link is verified.
Bluetooth disabled — enable it in Settings
Allow Nearby devices, then tap Refresh / Register HID. If permission was denied permanently, enable it in Android app settings.
HID Device Profile is unavailable on this phone.
HID service did not respond. Check Bluetooth, then retry. Profile support is unconfirmed.
Android reported that HID registration failed. Keep the app visible and retry; details are in Logcat.
Android did not confirm HID registration in time. Keep the app visible and retry; details are in Logcat.
Android cancelled HID registration. Keep the app in front and tap Refresh / Register HID.
Bluetooth HID service was lost. Check Bluetooth and retry.
The host did not connect. Check its HID support and pairing, then retry.
Could not disconnect. Retry or turn Bluetooth off in Settings.
Could not send the keyboard report. Check the connection.
Key release failed. Disconnecting to prevent a held key; check the host before reconnecting.
Bluetooth operation failed. Check Bluetooth and retry; details are in Logcat.
Bluetooth settings are unavailable on this device.
